{{Top|leg}}
The '''Protocol of Qah''' was a [[Yuuzhan Vong]] protocol used by the [[Shaper caste]]. It described the process by which reflexes could be imprinted onto a living being. In [[26 ABY/Legends|26.5 ABY]], [[Shaper Adept]] [[Nen Yim]] tried to [[Death/Legends|kill]] [[Master Shaper]] [[Onimi|Kae Kwaad]] by imprinting a series of reflexes on a [[grutchin]], which were keyed to the scent signature of Kwaad.<ref name="rebirth">''[[The New Jedi Order: Edge of Victory II: Rebirth]]'' </ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Protocol of Qah first appeared in the novel ''[[The New Jedi Order: Edge of Victory II: Rebirth]]'', written by [[Greg Keyes]] and released on [[July 31]], [[2001]].<ref name="rebirth" />
